findings.description: The tool schema URL is not validated, allowing potential SSRF attacks via malicious tool schemas.
findings.remediation: Validate that the tool schema URL is a safe external URL (e.g., allow only known domains or use an allowlist).

findings.description: The chat tools route has a critical path length of 4 services (our API -> OpenAI -> Tool API -> our API -> OpenAI), adding significant latency.
findings.remediation: Consider optimizing the tool call flow, such as by caching tool responses or reducing round trips.

findings.description: The POST handler in app/api/chat/tools/route.ts is excessively long (>150 lines), indicating high complexity and potential maintenance issues.
findings.remediation: Break down the function into smaller, focused functions (e.g., separate schema processing, tool execution, response handling).

findings.description: The chat tools route makes multiple sequential API calls to external tool services in a loop, increasing cost and latency.
findings.remediation: Batch tool calls where possible, or implement caching for tool responses.

findings.description: The application does not set security headers such as HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, or X-Content-Type-Options.
findings.remediation: Implement middleware to add security headers to all responses.

findings.description: The OpenAI HTTP client is instantiated per request, preventing connection reuse and increasing latency.
findings.remediation: Reuse the OpenAI client instance across requests (e.g., as a singleton or using dependency injection).

findings.description: External API calls to LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) lack timeout settings, risking indefinite hangs.
findings.remediation: Add timeout parameters to the API calls (e.g., timeout: 5000 for connect, 15000 for read).

findings.description: External API calls to LLM providers lack circuit breaker pattern, risking resource exhaustion during service outages.
findings.remediation: Implement a circuit breaker (e.g., using opossum or a custom solution) for external LLM API calls.

findings.description: External tool API calls in the chat tools route are not cached, leading to repeated costs for identical requests.
findings.remediation: Implement caching for tool API responses (e.g., in-memory or Redis) for idempotent operations.
